review_comments: This works, I did this as well initially but was looking for other places where it was missing

The data schema for the form input already has a default for emulate hardware. The only place we call this step directly with options is when reverting the options to the old add-on options, if the re-configure flow fails for some reason. I think it's ok to add a default False when reverting though, if there's no existing value for emulate hardware.
Side note: The re-configure flow is fragile, and I'm not really happy with how it works currently. I haven't concluded exactly how to make it better yet, though.
